name: Nanyang Technological University
description: Nanyang Technological University is a public research university established in 1991, with roots in Nanyang University (1955) and the Nanyang Technological Institute (1981). Based on a campus in western Singapore, it is known for engineering, science and business, and jointly runs the Lee Kong Chian School of Medicine with Imperial College London.
whyIncluded: One of Singapore's MOE-funded Autonomous Universities and, with NUS, one of the two comprehensive local universities that most Singaporean students weigh against overseas options.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Engineering
programmes.notes: Annual tuition for Academic Year 2026/2027 entrants, fixed for the whole degree ('All Programmes' row of the 'Tuition fees & grants' page; the old per-year 'accepted-programme-offer-in-2026' page now redirects to a 404). Citizen/PR: MOE Tuition Grant rates, excl. GST (GST subsidised by MOE). International: Tuition Grant rate for non-ASEAN students, incl. 9% GST (ASEAN S$18,050; non-subsidised S$40,600 lab-based / S$36,350 non-lab). 2025 and 2024 history from NTU's per-year fee PDFs. Excludes miscellaneous fees, which are billed per semester.

programmes.name: MSc (School of EEE self-financed coursework programme, e.g. MSc Communications Engineering)
programmes.notes: Self-financed programme; the page states students are not eligible for MOE subsidies. Minimum total tuition (30 AUs) incl. 9% GST for admission in AY2027 (from Aug 2027): S$58,403.07; AY2026: S$56,156.80. Applies to all nationalities. No Citizen/PR tier: the page confirms the S$5,000 NTU SC/PR subsidy only for AY2024-AY2025 and publishes no net SC/PR fee. Excludes miscellaneous fees (S$610 full-time for AY2025).

programmes.name: MSc in Artificial Intelligence (MSAI)
programmes.notes: Self-financed programme, not MOE-subsidised. Total tuition incl. 9% GST for AY2027/28 and after: S$65,748.80 (12 months minimum full-time), same for all nationalities. No Citizen/PR tier: SC/PR admitted from AY2025 get a S$5,000 NTU subsidy (up to S$15,000 with financial aid) plus a S$5,000 CCDS study grant (PRs from AY2026), but NTU publishes no net SC/PR fee. History from the official CCDS MSc tuition-fee schedule PDF linked from the page ('Past Tuition Fees'): AY2025 and AY2026 intakes S$63,220 (all nationalities); AY2024 intake had separate rates, SC S$39,785, PR S$47,415, international S$59,187 (all incl. 9% GST). Excludes miscellaneous fees.

programmes.name: Nanyang MBA (full-time)
programmes.notes: Self-financed programme, not MOE-subsidised. Programme fee for the 2026 intake on the programme page: S$89,380 incl. 9% GST (12- or 18-month programme), same for all nationalities. Citizen/PR: NBS's Fees & Funding page (ntu.edu.sg/business/admissions/graduate-studies/nanyang-mba/admissions/fees-funding) states that SC/PRs admitted to the full-time Nanyang MBA get a study grant of 10% of the tuition fee, so the SC/PR figure is 90% of the published fee. That page's fee schedule totals S$92,955.20 incl. GST without saying which intake it is for (probably 2027). Excludes the one-time miscellaneous fee of S$620.
